macOS 13+, Apple Silicon; Swift 5.0/SwiftUI; native speech-to-text menu bar app via Groq API.
`git checkout -b feature/<name>`
After Swift changes, always run:
`xcodebuild -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -configuration Debug build`
`xcodebuild test -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -destination 'platform=macOS'`
`./scripts/build-with-timing.sh`
`./scripts/check-duplicates.sh`
`./scripts/generate-docs.sh`
Sandbox disabled. Carefully edit `whisperswift/whisperswift.entitlements`. Logs: `/tmp/whisperswift.log`. Read relevant docs first.
